symptom: A genuinely newly-created blank project, or a reopened project with a persisted storyboard plan, can open the Creation surface with only 新建分镜方案; the existing storyboard editor and row 2 cannot be reached by the real vertical-spine task.
direct_cause: Blank project creation persisted a document and canvas defaults but no storyboard plan, while hydration restored storyboard designs with activeStoryboardId cleared; the dedicated storyboard workspace renders the editor only when an active plan exists.
class_root: Storyboard plan activation was not owned at the shared creation and hydration boundaries, so a valid structural or persisted design could exist without a selected design and no single transition reached the dedicated storyboard editor.
affected_population: Users creating a new blank project on desktop or browser fallback
The M0-M5 real Electron vertical-spine task that selects storyboard row 2 before any authored content exists
Users reopening a project whose storyboard plan/design payload is present but whose active design must be restored
entry_points: Visible new blank project action through createLocalProject
Existing storyboard planner/editor path through setStoryboardPlan and StoryboardWorkspace
internal_only_reason: The storyboard plan schema, project creation flow, and approved dedicated StoryboardWorkspace are internal Nomi contracts; no external source controls this invariant.
invariants: Every newly-created blank project has an active-document storyboard design with two empty, selectable rows and no authored prompts or anchors.
The dedicated StoryboardWorkspace remains the sole mounted home of StoryboardPlanEditor.
Selecting a storyboard row emits a stable storyboard reference consumed by the resident Agent without changing unrelated references or authored plan content.
generality_proof: Both desktop and browser project creation converge on src/workbench/project/projectRepository.ts, and all authored plans converge on StoryboardWorkspace/StoryboardPlanEditor. Supplying structural starter rows at creation and routing only the empty starter through the existing dedicated workspace prevents the same blank-project reachability failure across those entry points without seeding user-authored content.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Attach an empty two-row storyboard starter to newly-created blank projects at the shared creation boundary.
Select the starter design and transition to the dedicated StoryboardWorkspace so the editor has one home.
Forward the selected PlanShot identity to the Agent reference owner while retaining table selection semantics.
Make the whole row selectable while preserving nested controls, and expose the selected state to the real journey contract.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Desktop and browser fallback creation both call this shared renderer repository function before the project is handed to the desktop bridge or local storage.
Both planner writes and persisted project hydration converge here; each selects the first valid design for the active document while an empty restore remains unselected.

recurrence.reason: Any new project created without authored storyboard data can reproduce the missing-plan seam, and both desktop and browser fallback creation share the same payload construction.
same_class_scan: Searched createLocalProject, createProjectRecord, createDefaultWorkbenchProjectPayload, normalizePayload, hydrateStoryboardDesigns, setStoryboardPlan, StoryboardWorkspace, CreationWorkspace, and all StoryboardPlanEditor mounts.
Checked both desktop bridge creation and browser local-storage creation in projectRepository.workspace.test.ts.
Checked planner-created designs through setStoryboardPlan and the document sidebar planner launcher as the separate same-domain entry point.

prevention.invariant: A new blank project payload includes only structural storyboard rows (empty prompts, anchors, and title), and every hydrated active document with a valid design selects its first design so CreationWorkspace can reach StoryboardWorkspace.
prevention.failure_mode: Malformed or authored plans are not rewritten or routed by the starter predicate; they continue through the existing planner/card behavior, while a missing plan cannot leave the newly-created blank project without an editor entry.
prevention.strategy: Create the starter once at the shared project payload boundary, restore the active design at the shared hydration boundary, and reuse the existing dedicated editor route; row selection then forwards stable storyboard identity through the existing resident reference mechanism.

legacy_paths.rationale: No legacy editor implementation is retained or removed; the existing dedicated StoryboardWorkspace remains the only editor home.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The failure is caused by Nomi project payload and workspace routing; no third-party dependency controls the invariant.

migration: Existing projects and authored storyboard plans are left untouched. Newly-created blank projects receive structural rows; persisted empty starter rows are valid under the existing storyboard plan schema and can be edited or discarded normally.
residual_risks: The unchanged vertical-spine runner still uses a custom MCP stdio client after M1, so later M2-M5 results remain outside this repair.
A full real Electron and packaged rerun must prove the starter routing and row reference in the current build.
